prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there isn’t one single “best” — the right AI video-ad maker depends on what you need (real human presenters vs avatars, repurposing text/long-form content, creative control, budget, platform). Below are best-in-class choices by use-case so you can pick quickly.

Top picks by use-case

- For AI presenters / talking-head ads: Synthesia
  - Strengths: realistic avatars, many languages, easy script → video, enterprise features.
  - Weaknesses: costlier than simple template tools; limited full creative editing.

- For fast social ads and templates: InVideo or Promo.com
  - Strengths: large template & stock libraries, size/aspect-ratio presets for Facebook/Instagram/YouTube, quick turnaround.
  - Weaknesses: less “AI presenter” capability; results depend on templates.

- For repurposing long content to short ads: Pictory
  - Strengths: converts articles/long videos to short clips with captions and highlights; fast batch processing.
  - Weaknesses: less granular creative control.

- For advanced generative/creative editing: Runway
  - Strengths: powerful generative tools, background removal, frame-level edits, good for inventive visuals.
  - Weaknesses: steeper learning curve; more of a creative tool than template-driven ad maker.

- For transcript-based editing and voice cloning: Descript
  - Strengths: edit video like text, overdub voice cloning, great for tutorials and narration-driven ads.
  - Weaknesses: not focused on template-style ad generation.

- For personalized video ads at scale: Rephrase.ai / Idomoo
  - Strengths: dynamic personalization (name, offer) for large audiences.
  - Weaknesses: enterprise pricing usually.

- For simple, low-cost social clips: Lumen5 or Clipchamp
  - Strengths: very easy, free/cheap tiers, quick social-sized videos.
  - Weaknesses: can look templated, limited unique creative features.

How to choose
- Need a human presenter/ multilingual spokesperson → Synthesia or Movio/HeyGen.
- Need many short social ads fast from copy or long videos → Pictory, Lumen5, InVideo.
- Want cutting-edge visuals / creative editing → Runway.
- Need personalization for campaigns → Rephrase.ai or Idomoo.
- Budget-conscious, simple social creatives → Clipchamp or Promo.com.

Pricing & trials
- Most tools offer free trials or free tiers (often with watermark). Paid plans vary widely (from ~$10–50/month for small teams to custom enterprise pricing).

If you tell me:
- your budget,
- where you’ll run the ads (Facebook/Instagram/LinkedIn/YouTube),
- whether you want realistic presenters or stylized visuals,
- and whether you need personalization or lots of variations,

I’ll recommend the top 1–3 services and a quick workflow for making the ad. Which of those applies to you?
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
